limitations: Independent static closure of equal-key stability for valid QC96/TC104 row sorts, composed with credited last-row compaction and retained-count storage branch.
Logical source normalization uses an independently authored merge sort; no target execution, emulation or transplanted machine code.
Successful allocation, valid disjoint buffers, total unsigned20-byte memcmp and normal standard copy/cleanup behavior are premises.
Wire decoding, cryptographic signature validity, quorum/stake policy, allocator failure, physical flat/tree construction and full component completion are excluded.
Proof checks enumerate high-level tie/partition formulas, not captured instructions; tests validate owned logical results and are not native runtime-equivalence measurements.
